div.p: Pink Alley connects to Little Collins Street between Russell and Exhibition streets. In 1860, the Paddington Hotel, a ginger beer manufacturer and butcher could be found in Pink Alley. In 1910, the Adam and Eve hotel as well as a billiard table manufacturer were located in the alley.
